limitations.quote: //Clear the match pulse and retain the trailing 0.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the duplicate state encoding but also changed two post-match transitions that originally returned to idle, enabling extra detections after a valid 1 or an invalid cycle.

The test oracle assumed every overlapping 0110 in the valid-bit stream should match, so exhaustive stimulus confirmed the new behavior instead of checking whether the original post-match transitions were preserved.
